ratdom_well_wise3_50.m: Very good. Finally a learned being in this rat hole.

ratdom_well_wise3_52.m: In gratitude for the great joy I give you this rat skull.

ratdom_well_wise3_90.m: Come again whenever you want. It is a nice diversion to talk with someone with a bit of brain at least.

ratdom_quest.10: I woke up when I felt that something had bitten my toe. Apparently I had a nightmare - there were rats everywhere! Anyway, I wasn't even slightly recovered.
ratdom_quest.30: An ancient meditating man rewarded me with a rat skull for a wise discussion.
ratdom_quest.31: I took a leg bone of a rat from a gold hunter.
ratdom_quest.32: I stole a leg bone of a rat from the instrument maker.
ratdom_quest.33: In the center of a labyrinth I found a leg bone of a rat.
ratdom_quest.34: I took a leg bone of a rat from the dancing but vengeful and unforgiving skeletons.
ratdom_quest.35: I found the tail bones of a dead rat on a platform in a lake.
ratdom_quest.36: In a library I found the back bone of a big rat.
ratdom_quest.37: I got some rib bones of a rat from the skeleton leader.
ratdom_quest.50: A small, naughty rat called Clevred claimed that he could help me get out of here. In return, he required of me to help to find a yellow, round artifact.
ratdom_quest.52: I should look around in the rat cave. Clevred probably meant the Crossglen's supply cave.
ratdom_quest.60: In the depth of the supply cave I found a new statue, that resembles to my brother Andor.
ratdom_quest.70: The rats had erected the statue in honor of Andor for never killing rats. I should begin your search behind this statue.
ratdom_quest.80: I would need a pickaxe to tear down the statue.
ratdom_quest.82: Audir, the smith of Crossglen, sold me an old, sturdy pickaxe.
ratdom_quest.90: I tore down the statue of Andor. Behind it in the wall I found a hole in the shape of a bone.
ratdom_quest.100: I have put a bone into the hole, and the wall crumbled to dust.
ratdom_quest.110: A torch could help to see in the dark. Unfortunately, the torch is so heavy, that I would have to lift it with both hands.
ratdom_quest.120: I found a platform with a good view over Crossglen. Andor seemed to have been here many times.
ratdom_quest.200:
I found an exit from the caves to the surface. Cold icy wind was swirling up here on the Black Water mountain top. 
Astonishingly I wasn't alone here - Whootibarfag, a very old hermit seemed to have been waiting for me.
ratdom_quest.210: Whootibarfag was delighted with my help in rescuing Rat King Rah's skeleton. As a thank you, he let me in on the secret of the rat escape. This increased my ability to flee.
ratdom_quest.310: Wart, the warden to the halls of memory told me, that the access would be closed, until the rat memorial is restored. I should seek the bones of King Rah's skeleton.
ratdom_quest.320: Wart told me that he needed the head, the ribs and the back bone, 4 legs and the tail.
ratdom_quest.321: Wart said that I just have to find the skull.
ratdom_quest.322: Wart said that I just have to find the back bone.
ratdom_quest.323: Wart said that I have to find the rib bones.
ratdom_quest.324: Wart said that I just have to find the tail.
ratdom_quest.325: Wart said that I just have to find the fourth leg.
ratdom_quest.380: I donated King Rah's sword to the memory hall.
ratdom_quest.381: I sold King Rah's sword to the memory hall.
ratdom_quest.390: Wart was glad to have his rat memorial restored. He granted access to the memory hall now.
ratdom_quest.392: Wart told me that Fraedro was captured.
ratdom_quest.395: Wart allowed me to go deeper into the cave and have a word with Fraedro.
ratdom_quest.398: I believed in Fraedro's innocence and released him.
ratdom_quest.399: I attacked Fraedro to avenge the theft of King Rah.
ratdom_quest.400: I tried Fraedro's tiny golden key in a hole of the cavewall near to his prison. Immediatly the wall gave way to another passage.
ratdom_quest.900: I finally found the yellow artifact: It was a big round and smelly cheese! Golden yellow and so large that it would provide almost unlimited food. Clevred was overjoyed!
ratdom_quest.940: I told Clevred that I you couldn't help him further with the search. He then left me to search on his own.
ratdom_quest.942: Although I had told Clevred that I couldn't help him further with the search and he then left me, I met him in the caves again. I have decided to start the search again.
ratdom_quest.948: The big yellow cheese now weighs heavily in my bag. Small consolation for the loss of a friend, though.
ratdom_quest.950:
I fought my way through the roundlings. But Clevred was seriously wounded in the fight. He was just able to give me his beloved artifact. 
With a last breath he thanked me for my company and died in my arms.
ratdom_quest.960: I persuaded Clevred to leave the artifact behind. Clevred obeyed disappointedly, but he left me on the spot.
ratdom_quest.999: I fell asleep just in front of my bed. After long hours of deep and dreamless sleep I woke up - all the rats were gone! Was it only a dream?

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
